dslRule:
<!id: array-hashcode-fix>
<!description: Replace Object.hashCode() call on an array with java.util.Arrays.hashCode() for content-based hashing.>
<!severity: WARNING>
$array.hashCode()
=> java.util.Arrays.hashCode($array)
;;
